programs.name: dt1tosu
programs.purpose: Convert Sensors & Software DT1 ground-penetrating radar traces to SU traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: DT1TOSU - Convert ground-penetrating radar data in the

params.name: ns
params.default: computed: from first DT1 header ns
params.description: Number of input samples per trace; errors if the resulting value is zero.

params.name: dt
params.description: Apparent sample interval in milliseconds, multiplied by 1000 for the SU header.

params.name: swap
params.default: computed: 1 on a big-endian host, 0 on a little-endian host
params.description: Swap DT1 header and sample bytes.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Write first-header details for 1 or subsequent-header details for 2.

params.name: outpar
params.description: File opened for header details, even when verbose is zero.

params.name: list
params.description: Print the DT1 field legend to stderr.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Float-to-integer header conversions and time-of-day arithmetic depend on floating-point rounding. The DT1 structure layout and alignment are assumed; the ns override controls input consumption but output tr.ns is taken from each DT1 header.
programs.difficulty_reason: The converter handles a separate binary trace layout, byte swapping, and variable header fields.
programs.license_note: Credits say the program is based on UTULSA's sugpr by Chris Liner and Bill Underwood; the source describes the Sensors & Software DT1 format.

programs.name: segyhdrs
programs.purpose: Create ASCII text and binary reel headers for segywrite, optionally copying input traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SEGYHDRS - make SEG-Y ascii and binary headers for segywrite

params.name: ns
params.default: computed: from first input trace ns
params.description: Samples per trace; required when stdin is not redirected.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: from first input trace dt
params.description: Sample interval in microseconds; required when stdin is not redirected.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Binary header representation depends on native layout and byte order unless built with SUXDR.
programs.difficulty_reason: It initializes two headers and optionally passes traces through.

test_cases.description: Create headers and pass through traces with selected binary fields.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary jobid=7 format=5 fold=2 > copy.su

test_cases.description: Override trace-derived dimensions and sample interval.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=3 | segyhdrs ns=32 dt=2000 hfile=hdr2 bfile=bin2 tsort=2 > copy2.su

programs.name: segyread
programs.purpose: Read SEG-Y data, save reel headers, and convert traces to SU format.

params.name: tape
params.description: Input device or SEG-Y file; - selects stdin.

params.name: xfile
params.description: Output extended textual headers when present.

params.name: endian
params.default: computed: 1 on a big-endian host, 0 on a little-endian host
params.description: Host byte-order flag used for remapping and defaults.

params.name: swapdata
params.description: Data byte-order flag; the conversion code swaps when it is zero.

params.name: swapbhed
params.description: Binary-header byte-order flag; the code swaps when it is zero.

params.name: swaphdrs
params.description: Trace-header byte-order flag; the code swaps when it is zero.

params.name: ebcdic
params.description: Convert the text header from EBCDIC with dd.

params.name: buff
params.description: Use descriptor reads when nonzero and stdio reads when zero.

params.name: over
params.description: Allow an unsupported format and enable format override.

params.name: format
params.description: Override binary-header format when over is nonzero.

params.name: conv
params.description: Convert samples to native format and apply enabled weighting.

params.name: remap
params.description: Destination SU header keys for remapping.

params.name: byte
params.description: One-based byte positions and type suffixes for remapping; count must match remap when supplied.

params.name: trcwt
params.description: Apply the trace weighting factor when converting.

params.name: ns
params.description: Input samples per trace; errors if the resulting value is zero.

params.name: nextended
params.description: Parsed, but unconditionally overwritten with the binary-header value.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: IBM conversion assumes 32-bit IEEE floats and integers and uses type punning, signed shifts, and pointer arithmetic outside array bounds. Integer-to-float conversion and pow-based trace weighting can round. Float remapping with conv=1 converts a copied integer but then uses the original float. Partial reads can leave stale data.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines several sample formats, header remapping, endian handling, extended headers, and tape I/O state.

test_cases.description: Read an IBM-format SEG-Y file with a trace range.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary | segywrite tape=in.segy hfile=header bfile=binary && segyread tape=in.segy hfile=read.h bfile=read.b trmin=2 trmax=3 > out.su

test_cases.description: Read IEEE samples through stdin with stdio and remap a header field.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=3 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary format=5 | segywrite tape=in.segy hfile=header bfile=binary conv=0 format=5 && segyread tape=- buff=0 conv=1 remap=tracl byte=1l hfile=read.h bfile=read.b < in.segy > out.su

programs.license_note: No standard copyright notice appears; credits include SEP, Memorial University of Newfoundland, TU Delft, and Virginia Tech, and the IBM converter credits SEP and a translation by f2c.

programs.name: segyscan
programs.purpose: Scan SEG-Y trace headers and print minimum and maximum values interpreted as several numeric types.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SEGYSCAN -- SCANs SEGY file trace headers for min-max in  several
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The same header bytes are accessed through incompatible pointer types, which violates strict aliasing; arbitrary float and double bit patterns can include NaNs. Byte swapping assumes host representations, and the endian macro compares an array address to zero rather than inspecting its value.
programs.difficulty_reason: It parses SEG-Y record sizes and scans each header through multiple numeric interpretations.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary | segywrite tape=in.segy hfile=header bfile=binary && segyscan < in.segy > scan.txt
suspike nt=32 ntr=3 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary format=5 | segywrite tape=in.segy hfile=header bfile=binary conv=0 format=5 && segyscan < in.segy > scan.txt

programs.name: segywrite
programs.purpose: Write SU traces and supplied reel headers as SEG-Y data to a file or tape device.

params.name: tape
params.description: Output SEG-Y file or tape device.

params.name: buff
params.description: Use descriptor writes when nonzero and stdio writes when zero.

params.name: conv
params.description: Convert samples from IEEE to IBM format.

params.name: endian
params.default: computed: 1 on a big-endian host, 0 on a little-endian host
params.description: Host byte-order flag used for output conversion.

params.name: format
params.description: Override the binary header format field; does not select sample conversion.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: IEEE-to-IBM conversion discards up to three mantissa bits and assumes 32-bit IEEE floats and integers; it uses type punning and signed shifts with platform-dependent or undefined behavior. Output sample format is controlled separately by conv and the header format field.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines reel and trace header serialization, IBM conversion, byte order, and tape I/O.

test_cases.description: Write IBM-format SEG-Y with a restricted trace range.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary | segywrite tape=out.segy hfile=header bfile=binary trmin=2 trmax=3

test_cases.description: Write IEEE samples and an ASCII text header using stdio.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=3 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=binary format=5 | segywrite tape=out.segy hfile=header bfile=binary format=5 conv=0 ebcdic=0 buff=0

programs.license_note: Credits include SEP's Einar Kjartansson; the IBM conversion routine credits CWP's Brian Sumner.

programs.name: setbhed
programs.purpose: Create a binary reel header from command-line or parameter-file values.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SETBHED - SET the fields in a SEGY Binary tape HEaDer file, as would be

params.name: par
params.description: Parameter file handled by the getpar infrastructure.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Binary header representation depends on native layout and byte order; values assigned to short fields are narrowed.
programs.difficulty_reason: It initializes and writes a fixed-size binary header from parameters.

test_cases.description: Create a header and use it to write generated traces.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=initial > in.su && setbhed bfile=binary hns=64 hdt=4000 format=1 jobid=7 && segywrite tape=out.segy hfile=header bfile=binary < in.su

test_cases.description: Create an IEEE header with additional fields and write generated traces.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=3 | segyhdrs hfile=header bfile=initial > in.su && setbhed bfile=binary hns=32 hdt=2000 format=5 fold=2 tsort=2 && segywrite tape=out.segy hfile=header bfile=binary conv=0 < in.su
